title: Hongqi Shenmai Decoction ameliorates post-myocardial infarction heart failure by preserving mitochondrial cardiolipin homeostasis via attenuation of EGFR/JAK2-STAT3 signaling.
authors: Bo, Haohao; Liu, Da; Zhai, Chunxiang; Chen, Zhaoyang; Hu, Ruimeng; Guo, Yihong; Li, Yansong; Chen, Bin; Wang, Xindong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过EGFR/JAK2-STAT3信号通路保护心肌梗死后心衰中的线粒体心磷脂稳态，属于心血管疾病机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Post-myocardial infarction heart failure (post-MI HF) is driven by adverse ventricular remodeling and mitochondrial dysfunction. Cardiolipin is essential for mitochondrial integrity, but its upstream regulation in failing myocardium remains unclear. Whether Hongqi Shenmai Decoction (HQSMD) preserves cardiolipin homeostasis through epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)/Janus kinase 2 (JAK2)-signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) signaling has not been defined. PURPOSE: To determine whether HQSMD alleviates post-MI HF by preserving cardiolipin-related metabolic homeostasis through modulation of the EGFR/JAK2-STAT3 pathway. STUDY DESIGN: An in vivo post-MI HF mouse model and an in vitro oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R)-injured AC16 cardiomyocyte model were integrated with chemical profiling, multi-omics analysis, target validation, and epidermal growth factor (EGF)-mediated rescue experiments. METHODS: Cardiac function, infarct injury, fibrosis, oxidative stress, mitochondrial ultrastructure, and mitochondrial function were assessed. Ultra-performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry, transcriptomics, untargeted metabolomics, molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, western blotting, immunofluorescence, and cardiolipin-related functional assays were performed. RESULTS: HQSMD improved cardiac function and attenuated infarction, remodeling, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial injury in post-MI HF mice. Multi-omics analyses implicated EGFR/JAK-STAT signaling and cardiolipin-related glycerophospholipid disturbances. HQSMD suppressed MI- or OGD/R-induced phosphorylation of EGFR, JAK2, and STAT3 Tyr705 while preserving mitochondrial STAT3/Ser727 signaling. In cardiomyocytes, HQSMD reduced apoptosis and restored mitochondrial dynamics, biogenesis, redox balance, membrane potential, mPTP function, cardiolipin-associated fluorescence, and cardiolipin-related enzyme expression. EGF partially reversed these effects. CONCLUSION: HQSMD protects against post-MI HF mainly by attenuating pathological EGFR/JAK2-dependent STAT3 Tyr705 activation, thereby preserving cardiolipin-related metabolic homeostasis and mitochondrial integrity.
abstract_zh: 背景：心肌梗死后心力衰竭（post-MI HF）由不良心室重构和线粒体功能障碍驱动。心磷脂对线粒体完整性至关重要，但其在衰竭心肌中的上游调控仍不清楚。红芪参麦汤（HQSMD）是否通过表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）/Janus激酶2（JAK2）-信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）信号通路维持心磷脂稳态尚未明确。目的：确定HQSMD是否通过调节EGFR/JAK2-STAT3通路维持心磷脂相关代谢稳态，从而缓解心肌梗死后心力衰竭。研究设计：将体内心肌梗死后心力衰竭小鼠模型和体外氧糖剥夺/复氧（OGD/R）损伤的AC16心肌细胞模型，与化学谱分析、多组学分析、靶点验证及表皮生长因子（EGF）介导的拯救实验相结合。方法：评估心脏功能、梗死损伤、纤维化、氧化应激、线粒体超微结构和线粒体功能。进行了超高效液相色谱-质谱联用、转录组学、非靶向代谢组学、分子对接、表面等离子体共振、蛋白质印迹、免疫荧光及心磷脂相关功能检测。结果：HQSMD改善了心肌梗死后心力衰竭小鼠的心脏功能，并减轻了梗死、重构、氧化应激和线粒体损伤。多组学分析提示EGFR/JAK-STAT信号通路及心磷脂相关甘油磷脂紊乱。HQSMD抑制了MI或OGD/R诱导的EGFR、JAK2和STAT3 Tyr705磷酸化，同时保留线粒体STAT3/Ser727信号。在心肌细胞中，HQSMD减少凋亡，并恢复线粒体动力学、生物发生、氧化还原平衡、膜电位、mPTP功能、心磷脂相关荧光及心磷脂相关酶表达。EGF部分逆转了这些效应。结论：HQSMD主要通过减弱病理性EGFR/JAK2依赖性STAT3 Tyr705激活来保护心肌梗死后心力衰竭，从而维持心磷脂相关代谢稳态和线粒体完整性。
